name: Tender Dance
description: The creature performs a captivating dance. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage and become paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
